tasks.short: Recommend vitamin and mineral supplements to patients and children

steps.what: Read the patients record for vitamin and mineral need
Look up the approved vitamin supplements leaflet line
Decide which supplements to recommend to these patients
Tell the patients and children which supplements to use
Write the supplements recommendation in the health record

tasks.design: Approved supplement lines sit in the {DOCS} with trimester, child age and deficiency flags. A match from the {OTHER} midwifery record shows the line that fits those flags. The midwife still chooses the supplement, tells the patient, and writes the note herself.
tasks.previous_blocker: The right supplement depends on this pregnancy or this child, and a leaflet page is not a decision.
tasks.enabler_now: Approved lines can be stored with trimester, age and lab flags, so the matching line is waiting without a model.
tasks.still_hard: She still judges diet, interactions and whether a supplement is wrong for this patient. The lookup must not choose the dose.
tasks.human_edge: She is accountable for the supplement she names. The leaflet does not know this patient's diet.
tasks.altitude: The consult is unchanged. She still decides the supplement and still says it. She no longer hunts the leaflet page when the flags are already stored.

reach.task: Tell a pregnant patient when food should change before a supplement is added
reach.learn: Which deficiency on her record is a diet change rather than a supplement

evidence.claim: Matching a stored trimester or deficiency flag to an approved leaflet line is a field lookup. It does not choose the supplement.
Software that supplies information used for a therapeutic decision is a medical device in a higher class. This design only retrieves an approved line; the midwife decides.
The recommendation note is part of the dossier she keeps for the statutory period.
Pregnancy and child health details are special-category data, so the match stays inside the practice record.
A registered midwife owns the advice and the record it is written in.

assumptions: The focal role is the midwife in a mid-size European practice. She recommends; she does not hand the choice to a model.

Structured input for the lookup: trimester or child age, and a deficiency flag already stored on the {OTHER} record. The lab or a prior prenatal visit produces the flag. If it is missing, she still reads the record and decides with no lookup.
The practice clinical lead keeps the approved lines (dose, trimester or age, contraindication). That is her work. The midwife on this task does not keep the list, so her incremental hours are zero.
The spoken advice is not a versioned send. The dossier note is her own writing in the same record, not a second filing step.
The match is not used to score her.
unknowns: Whether this practice already stores trimester and deficiency as fields, or only as free text in the note.
Whether national rules treat a supplement recommendation as advice or as a prescription she must sign.
research_questions: Which supplement lines does the clinical lead already treat as approved for pregnancy and for children?

already_counted.description: Choosing the supplement, telling the patient and writing the note stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: The practice clinical lead keeps the approved supplement lines current. That upkeep is her hours, not machine runtime.
The midwife does not keep the supplement list, so she has no extra hours on this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only a leaflet hunt with a stored trimester and deficiency flag disappears. When the flag is missing, or the line does not cover this diet, she still looks it up herself, so most consults save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide community health and social resource information

steps.what: Hear the community health need from the patient
Look up community resources that match the need
Decide which social resources fit this family
Provide the community health resources information

tasks.design: Community resources sit in the {DOCS} with a need code, hours, a referral rule and a last-checked date. After the midwife hears the need, the matching entries are shown from that directory. She still chooses which one this family can use, and she says it herself. There is no patient-facing chat.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hours and referral rules change and live in folders and in people's memory.
tasks.enabler_now: A directory keyed by need code can return the current entry without a model.
tasks.still_hard: She still decides whether this family should be offered that service, and she still says it in the consult.
tasks.human_edge: She knows whether the family can actually use the service. A directory does not.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in who speaks to the patient. She spends less time searching for a phone number and hours when the need has a directory code.

reach.task: See which local health resource the ward already gives families after discharge
reach.learn: Which community resource is already in use, so she does not send the family to a duplicate

evidence.claim: Matching a need code to a maintained directory entry is configuration. It does not decide whether the family should be offered the service.
Giving a patient community resource information is not an eligibility decision by a public authority under Annex III.
A patient-facing chat would have to say it is automated. This design does not use one; the midwife speaks the information.
The need she hears can be special-category health data, so the directory match stays inside the practice.

assumptions: She provides the information in the consult. She does not publish it or send a versioned message.

Structured input: a need code she names after listening, and directory fields kept by the practice coordinator (name, hours, referral rule, last-checked date). If the need has no code, she still searches and the lookup does not run.
The coordinator's upkeep is other-role hours. The midwife does not keep the directory, so her incremental hours are zero.
The directory is not used to score her.
unknowns: How often a need in this practice already has a stable code, versus a one-off family situation.
Whether the municipality, rather than the practice, is the publisher of the resource list she is allowed to quote.
research_questions: Which community resources does this practice already hand out, and who last checked the hours?

already_counted.description: Hearing the need, choosing the resource and telling the patient stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: The practice coordinator keeps the community resource directory current. That upkeep is her hours, not machine runtime.
The midwife does not keep the directory, so she has no extra hours on this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the search for hours and a referral rule disappears, and only when the need has a directory code. A family situation with no code still takes the full search.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compile and evaluate clinical practice statistics

steps.what: Read which clinical cases belong in this practice period
Compile the practice statistics from the returned comparison
Evaluate what the clinical practice statistics mean
Discuss the practice statistics with the partners

tasks.design: Case rows already sit in the {OTHER} midwifery record from care. The registry comparison return replaces the {SPREADSHEET} totals she rebuilds today. She still decides what a difference means for this practice and discusses it with her partners. The return is not sent onward from this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Her figures and the national comparison lived apart, so she rebuilt the totals by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: The registry return already sets her figures beside others, so the second workbook is unnecessary when the cohort is complete.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to say what a gap means. A total does not make that judgement.
tasks.human_edge: She decides whether a difference in the figures needs a change in how the practice works.

ambition.what: Read the practice comparison every quarter, not only at the yearly sitting, because the return is already there.

tasks.altitude: The yearly rebuild of totals goes away when the return is in. She still decides what the figures mean, and she can look more often without a new workbook.

reach.role: Health Information Technologists and Medical Registrars
reach.task: See how a registry return is read without typing the same cases again
reach.learn: Which comparison on the return is already final and which gap she still has to interpret

evidence.claim: mijnPerined is where midwives register in their own software, deliver the national dataset and compare their own figures with others. That returned comparison is what replaces the second workbook.
Summing registered fields is deterministic. Deciding what a difference means for this practice is not.
Practice statistics are special-category health data. The comparison stays inside the practice and is not a public extract of persons.
She owns the practice record the figures come from.

assumptions: Delivering the national dataset is the registration the practice software already does during care. This task does not add a second send.

Structured input: case rows she entered at the birth or the visit, and the registry comparison return built from those rows. The practice administrator keeps the list of which local fields count in the cohort. If the return is missing, she still totals by hand and s2 does not apply.
Registry compute is existing runtime and is not her labour. Her saving is only the workbook she stops rebuilding.
She does not keep the field list, so her incremental hours are zero. The comparison is not used to score her.
unknowns: Whether this practice already receives a comparison return, or only a raw extract she still totals.
Whether national rules require a works-council talk before practice figures are shown on a shared view.
research_questions: Which figures does she still retype today, and which already come back on the registry return?

already_counted.description: Checking the cohort, evaluating the figures and the partner discussion stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: The practice administrator keeps the list of which record fields count in the local cohort. That upkeep is her hours, not machine runtime.
The midwife does not keep that field list, so she has no extra hours on this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The cut is the workbook rebuild, and only when the registry comparison has already returned for a complete cohort. A missing return means she still totals by hand, which is the low end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the birth record that the certificates must follow
Confirm the birth names and time with the parents
Copy stored birth fields onto the certificates
Check the birth certificates against the birth record
Complete the filing of the checked birth certificates

tasks.design: Time, place and attendant fields already sit on the {OTHER} birth record. After the parents confirm the names, a field map fills the {GOV_PORTAL} certificate. The midwife checks that draft against the record and the confirmed names, and only then signs and files that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Names, time and place are copied by hand onto the civil form, and a wrong field is hard to undo.
tasks.enabler_now: Those fields are already structured on the birth record, so the form boxes can be filled by a map once the parents have confirmed the names.
tasks.still_hard: She still confirms the names with the parents, still checks the child is the right one, and still signs. The map does not file the certificate.
tasks.human_edge: She signs the certificate. A wrong name is hers to catch.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes about who signs. The re-key onto the form goes away. The check and the filing stay with her.

reach.task: See how a civil form box maps to a field already stored on the birth record
reach.learn: Which certificate box is a straight copy and which one still needs the parents' confirmation

evidence.claim: Copying structured birth fields into named form boxes is configuration. It does not decide that the certificate is right.
The birth record is part of the dossier she keeps for the statutory period. The certificate she files is a separate official act.
The certificate carries special-category health data and leaves the practice, so she checks the version before it is filed.
A registered midwife owns the birth record and is the attendant who signs.

assumptions: Birth fields (time, place, sex, attendant) are captured on the {OTHER} record during the birth, before this task. This task does not re-enter them.

The parents' confirmed names are captured in s2, before the form is filled. The practice administrator keeps the map from record field to certificate box. That upkeep is her hours, not machine runtime. The midwife does not keep the map, so her incremental hours are zero.
Filing is a real send to the civil registry, gated on the checked version. It is not a save inside the midwifery record, and it keeps its full time.
A change to a name after the check voids the approval.
unknowns: Whether this country's civil form accepts a structured feed or only a portal she must still open by hand.
Whether the parents, rather than the midwife, are the ones who file, with her signature only on a medical notice.
research_questions: Which certificate boxes are copied from the birth record today, and which does she still ask the parents?

already_counted.description: Confirming names with the parents, checking the certificate and filing it stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: The practice administrator keeps the map from birth-record field to certificate box. That upkeep is her hours, not machine runtime.
The midwife does not keep the certificate field map, so she has no extra hours on this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the re-key from the birth record onto the civil form disappears, and only when those fields and the confirmed names are already stored. The check and the filing stay. A form that rejects the feed leaves the re-key in place, which is the low end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still chooses the supplement, still tells the patient which local resource fits, still says what the practice figures mean, and still signs the birth certificate. Pages and totals she used to rebuild are waiting when the fields are already stored.
reach: Health Information Technologists and Medical Registrars
skills_to_grow: Tell a leaflet line from the supplement this patient should take
Choose a community resource the family can actually use
Read a practice comparison without rebuilding the totals
Check a birth certificate name before she signs
role.ambitious_version: The comparison is there every quarter, and the certificate fields are filled before she checks them. She still decides, still speaks to the patient, and still signs.
